title: Customer Clustering Using K-Means
headline: Finding the people behind the patterns.
summary: A customer segmentation study that turns income and spending behavior into a more useful picture of an audience.

cover.alt: The original K-means output, plotting customer income and spending score with five clusters and their centers.

coverNote: Chart from the project’s published analysis. The repository includes the notebook and recommendations.

blocks.html:
The question

What distinct customer groups appear when income and spending behavior are considered together?

The approach

Explore the customer data, check its structure and missing values, and use the Elbow Method to select a cluster count. Apply K-means and visualize the resulting groups.

What it shows

Five segments with different spending patterns. These groups support more specific ideas for promotions, customer retention and personalized offers.
